versions.changelog:
- Initial release of ADHD Daily Planner skill.
- Provides time-blind friendly planning, executive function support, and flexible daily structure for ADHD brains.
- Includes strategies for realistic time estimation, dopamine-aware task design, and building adaptive systems.
- Features planning templates, transition buffers, and tools to externalize working memory.
- Emphasizes shame-free, neurodivergent-affirming advice over traditional productivity methods.
